The proofs and computations have not yet received independent human verification or Lean formalization. Exact checks establish their stated computational scope; they do not replace the categorical arguments.

Current classification · 6 open questions

R8_3_1768 is excluded from complex fusion categorification. A pivotal conjugation-pairing lemma forces even multiplicities that contradict its complete necessary indicator system. The proof uses the established sphericalization/Galois existence reduction. Six exact separation certificates have been replayed.

The remaining cases are R6_4_155, R6_8_1660, R8_3_928, R8_3_941, R8_3_1154 and R9_2_137. Their strengthened restrictions supply neither another general exclusion nor a new model.

The six remaining questions

Rank six · R6_4_155

Every positive Morita dual has the same based ring. In the specified order-32 near-group construction route, the parent group must be C4 × C2³. Compatible pointed data exist, but the parent category and required algebra are unconstructed. General categorification remains unresolved.

Case record and proof →

Rank six · R6_8_1660

A nonreal dimension-weighted third indicator excludes real forms and braided representatives in the positive Morita class. The center is prime, excluding smaller direct modular sources. The proposed algebra 1+X and its R941 Morita partner remain conditional.

Case record and proof →

Rank eight · three remaining cases

R8_3_928. Three of four necessary center patterns are excluded. The surviving rank-20 factor agrees exactly with Anyon Atlas B20-02148, Galois orbit 20.167. Neither its categorical realization nor the proposed separable algebra is established; R928 remains unresolved. B20-02148 in The Anyon Atlas ↗

R8_3_941. The center of a positive representative is prime and obeys the direct modular-source obstruction. Its fermion centralizer is nonsplit and s-simple. The proposed R1660–R941 Morita equivalence still requires a category and a separable algebra 1+X.

R8_3_1154. One branch of a hypothetical smallest algebra 1+X4 forces an explicit simple rank-seven Morita-dual fusion ring. The algebra and module associators are unconstructed, and the other based-module branch also survives. General categorification remains unresolved.

Unified rank-eight manuscript →

Rank nine · R9_2_137

Full-column Galois symmetry and nine exact integral Verlinde bounds exclude the positive Tambara–Yamagami sign in a positive spherical representative. The negative sign retains a checked rational necessary-condition witness, not a categorification. The ring remains unresolved.

Case record and proof → · Unified rank-nine multiplicity-two manuscript

What has been verified

The project distinguishes categorical hypotheses and cited theorems from tensor identities, finite-domain certificates, source hashes and publication checks. Passing scalar or matrix checks does not establish a missing categorical premise.

The current R1768 exclusion has two separate agent proof reviews and a complete replay of the six required rational certificates. All 28 current finite checks passed, including nine exact certificates excluding the positive TY sign for R137 and the complete B20-02148 modular-data comparison. The negative-sign rational witness remains a necessary-system witness. The inherited general-complex gates and center-domain theorems remain explicit mathematical dependencies.

Proof repairs and reproducibility

For R8_3_436, the earlier unitarity-dependent parameterization premise remains withdrawn; its current general exclusion uses an independent spherical-equivariantization and formal-codegree proof. The rank-eight manuscript also includes the R8_2_24 rigidity argument. Current manuscripts incorporate the accepted proof repairs.

Original evidence retains its source context. The published runner checks current tensors, source bindings and saved certificates without treating an obsolete research snapshot as a new classification decision.
